$comment: Census safety policy. Written by the main 2.0 session only (plan 6.1). Sources: docs/v2/PLAN.md sections 1.4 (target tiers), 4.3 (vocabularies), 5.3 (live-lane rules) and Appendix B (deny-list seed). Every list here is a seed; Appendix B says the lists are regenerated from census-verified labels at the Phase 4 exit and signed off by the owner.

dispositions.$comment: `deferred` is a non-terminal status on an active row, never a disposition (plan 1.4). `blocked`, `duplicate-of` and `subsumed-by` carry a reference part (`blocked:<probe id>`, `duplicate-of:<id>`, `subsumed-by:<id>`).

window.why: UI container: readable means listable with its children

menu-item.why: UI action; needs a pass oracle

dialog.why: UI container; open-risk and commit-risk are split per row

control.why: UI action or state inside a container

property.why: Knowledge row: property field of a game class; operability lives on the parent container tool

property-editor.why: One of the 31 UIWidgets kinds; its popup is a child container

shortcut.why: Knowledge row; driven through the action it binds

tool.why: World Editor tool: dialog-free or worker-callable ones are driven; otherwise a disposition

canvas-gesture.why: Manual row: no label, slot, class or file trace (plan 4.6)

region.why: Opaque region; operations on it get their own rows

hazard-dialog.why: Catalogued as met; never answered automatically

class.why: Knowledge row for the Workbench API scope

method.why: Workbench API method: T5 or a disposition

static-method.why: Workbench API static: T5 or a disposition

event.why: Workbench API event: T5 or a disposition

plugin.why: Dialog-free or worker-callable plugins are driven; otherwise re-implemented logic, CLI or GUI path; else a disposition. RunCommandline is never called live.

plugin-setting.why: Settings read and write through the plugin bridge; a live test promotes to T5

plugin-cli-arg.why: CLI switch of a plugin; T5 where safe

net-function.why: Native NET function: T5 or a disposition

net-handler.why: Bohemia handler: T5 or a disposition; modal handlers (BakeInfo, EBTInfo) are excluded

net-field.why: Request or response field: knowledge row

cli-switch.why: T5 where safe; publish and login switches excluded

file-type.why: Minimum for text formats; T5 writable only where a lossless writer and engine acceptance are proven; binary formats header read or not-automatable

setting-key.why: Readable; T4 writable only through a sandbox settings file; the registry is read-only by default (D4)

option.why: UI state: readable, drivable where settable

diag-menu.why: Knowledge row, own shard; T3/T4 where U34 finds a path

debug-panel.why: In-play debug panel; T3 or T4 where W8 finds a path

mcp-tool.why: The MCP's own surface: every tool action links to at least one row (G8) and has a live test

row_defaults.$comment: Defaults a ledger row takes when no observation and no state patch states its risk or a candidate path (DEC-023). They let a measured row reach T1. They are never a confirmation: risk_confirmed stays false until a state patch confirms it, and a default path has status candidate. risk_name_rules are tried in order on the row's own name (method, action, switch or label) before risk_by_kind; patterns are case-sensitive regular expressions. Destructive is never assigned by a name rule: it comes from an observation, a state patch or the deny lists below.

risk_overrides.$comment: A UI action, CLI switch or handler whose risk is destructive, credential or external has target T2 plus a disposition; it is documented, walked read-only, never committed by default (plan 1.4).

cli_run.$comment: wb_cli_run v2 (DEC-048 package B) runs only the verbs and CLI plugins listed here; every other run verb is NOT_ALLOWLISTED; packAddon and publishAddon are prepare-only (argv shown, nothing spawned) and bypass the list by design. Written by the main session. Entries: verb:openProject (-gproj with -exitAfterInit: exits by itself, DEC-033 U1), verb:buildScripts (-gproj -wbModule=ScriptEditor -validate=<CFG>: the harness ends the process on 'Script validation successful.', DEC-035), plugin:AddonBuildInfoTool (-wbModule=ResourceManager -plugin=AddonBuildInfoTool with -addonPath= in one token, DEC-037). Without the -wbModule switch neither runs on 1.9.0.37: Workbench idles to the timeout (2026-11-14, docs/v2/inbox/phase7/cli-battery-1.9.md). Not listed until measured: navmeshGenerate, forceSaveAll, -buildData (unresolved, DEC-047 L7). Publish and Workshop verbs are never listed (plan 5.7).

plugin_args.$comment: The argument keys wb_cli_run may pass to a listed CLI plugin as -key=value (DEC-048 package B, review finding B-1: a key is never a Workbench switch). AddonBuildInfoTool: addonPath and ciInfoDst, the two keys S-A-9 and S-A-10 passed (DEC-036, DEC-037). Both are required and path-ruled in wb-cli-run.ts PLUGIN_PATH_RULES (total audit live-client-03): addonPath is the project folder itself, ciInfoDst an absolute .json file under the artifacts folder.

plugin_run_allow_list.$comment: wb_plugin run drives only these (module, class) pairs. DEC-103: the three classes whose Run() was read by hand in the pak and only logs or moves the editor camera (docs/v2/inbox/phase6/plugin-safety-review.md); SCR_LocStatusPlugin is held (it unlocks rows for editing).

plugin_read_allow_list.$comment: EMCP_WB_Plugin describe/getSettings (DEC-048 3.3) resolve only these typenames (module, class). Read live in S-D (DEC-042 U10: GetPlugin instance and attribute reads answered for three plugins; the call brings the module window to the front). Written by the main session; setSettings and run stay GATED whatever this list says.

execute_action.$comment: ExecuteAction only with paths on this allow-list (plan 5.3). Entries are arrays of path segments, e.g. ["Window", "Resource Browser"]; the handler matches every segment exactly (no case folding, no mnemonic stripping) and the generator derives no variant. DEC-100 (main, 2026-11-14; narrows DEC-092 and DEC-095): allow_list holds ONLY paths with a passing live result. That is 8 of the 9 entries before DEC-092 (S-D U9's Window > Hierarchy and Log Console with their mnemonic and lower-case forms; U19's Edit > Undo, moved to S-E by DEC-040, the sandbox's tiny world only; S-F U31's Utilities > Qt Introspection Tool; the ninth, P-W8-22's refusal item File > Options..., left the list after the Phase 7 total audit, live-tools-b-1: a dialog opener on the compiled list let wb_module action open the modal Options dialog, so no dialog opener is compiled and both wb_menu run and wb_module action refuse a trailing ellipsis MODAL_HAZARD), plus the 50 paths W9 runs 1 to 3 toggled and restored (tests/live/w9.live.ts W9.1, live results in the sittings' w9-live-*.jsonl, promoted by EV-W9-013, EV-W9-027 and EV-W9-039), plus the 2 view items whose effect W9 run 3 read and restored (Entities > Focus Selection and Select Layer, W9.2): 58 entries. The path list is not module-scoped: a path proven in one module is listed for every module. candidates holds the other 48 paths DEC-092 and DEC-095 had added from an offline classification (no live run proved them). No shipped tool or handler reads candidates: scripts/gen-action-allowlist.ts never compiles them into EMCP_WB_ActionAllowList.c, so wb_menu run and wb_module action refuse them NOT_ALLOWLISTED. scripts/live/gen-probe-allowlist.ts compiles them into the development-only probe pack (mod-dev/probe/ECEN_ProbeAllowList.c Candidates, never shipped), whose executeAction runs one only when the request says candidate: true and the open project is the 2.0 sandbox; only a live battery passes it (w9.live.ts --candidates, with the read-only probe pack installed for the sitting). dialog_openers holds the paths a live run observed opening a dialog: such a path is never on allow_list or candidates (both generators refuse it; tests/scripts/gen-action-allowlist.test.ts asserts it). Window > Manage Layouts opened the Manage Layouts dialog in W8 regress1 (w8-50-p22-menu-runs, EV-W8-277), with no trailing ellipsis. live_lane.dialog_openers.paths is a different list: the openers a dialog census step may open on purpose. Never dictionary-probe. The 263 safe-state rows wait for a second ruling (docs/v2/inbox/phase6/menu-safe-state-review.md).

probe.$comment: Lists compiled into the read-only probe pack (mod-dev/probe/ECEN_ProbeAllowList.c) by scripts/live/gen-probe-allowlist.ts (plan 5.4 item 7). diag_read_engine_ids: entries {id, ledger_row}, the engine diag options diagRead may read by id; empty, so diagRead reads script options by name only.

probe_mut.$comment: Lists compiled into the mutating probe pack (mod-dev/probe-mut/ECEN_ProbeMutLists.c) by scripts/live/gen-probe-allowlist.ts. plugin_run_allow_list: entries {module, class, ledger_row, evidence}, the plugins pluginRunDialogFree may Run(); diag_set_allow_list: entries {key, ledger_row}, the diag options diagSet may change. One entry each for sitting S-E on the owner's ruling of 2026-10-08 (Q8), on the condition that every value is set back in the same step; the step restores the diag option and the plugin's empty entity action is undone or left unsaved.

plugin_run_allow_list.evidence: pak:scripts/WorkbenchGame/WorldEditor/SCR_SnapAndOrientToTerrainPlugin.c#L13-L60 read 2026-10-08: Run() opens no dialog; it returns on a missing module, API or world, then BeginEntityAction, a loop over the selected entities (empty when nothing is selected) and EndEntityAction; its only writes are SetVariableValue on selected entities, so with an empty selection it writes nothing.

deny_lists.$comment: Appendix B. Three lists because opening a dialog and committing it are different risks.

openers_main_never_invokes.$comment: The dialog behind each is still censused: the owner clicks the opener after an in-chat go, main reads the open dialog, the owner closes it with Cancel.

never_invoked_by_any_tool.$comment: A human commits. Credential fields are never typed into (plan 1.3).

local_destructive_confirmation_required.$comment: Never invoked during the census; by tools only with an explicit confirmation parameter.

dry_run.$comment: Every live script has a dry-run mode that fails if it would issue an invoke on a menu leaf, an Enter or accelerator key, or a deny-listed path (plan 6.2 BATTERY-AUTHOR). The only exceptions are named here.

exceptions.why: D14 and owner ruling 1 (2026-10-10): the one watched test of a scripted Cancel, on the Options dialog L04 opens itself (sf-26: owned, title Options, window class Qt683QWindowIcon). Further dialogs get their own exception only after this test passes.

modal_watchdog.$comment: src/gui/modal-watchdog.ts (DEC-048 3.5) answers a detected dialog only by a rule listed here; an empty list is the design's default, report and wait (design section 6, DEC-042 U6). It never answers 'Script Authorization Required' whatever this list says. Written by the main session.

uia_menu.$comment: Caps and title allow-list of the active menu tool tools/uia/menus.py (S-F B4), read by the uia-menu kind of scripts/live/dry-run.ts. titles: the eight application menu-bar titles S-C's walk read (u7-walk.json of 2026-10-07T00-53-19-167Z, DEC-040); the ninth menu item of that walk, System (the title-bar system menu in its own MenuBar, which holds Close), is left out on purpose. calls: the only UIA pattern calls the tool makes. titles_by_module (Phase 4, D11, corrected by the design refutation): the titles per census module a uia-menu naming its module may expand: the World Editor has nine (File, Edit, View, Game, Tools, Window, Plugins, Entities, Help), the Resource Manager the eight above; a uia-menu naming a module may expand at most that module's count (maxMenus applies to plans that name no module). A module enters with the titles its first passive walk reads, by main. Launcher is listed empty on purpose (the entries must be title arrays, so the note lives here): the first L14 walk fills it, and until then L14 plans no uia-menu. titles stays for plans that name no module (the S-F script).
uia_menu.$comment_sub_editors: P4-9 (DEC-056 ruling 9): a ResourceManager.<X> sub-editor is a tab of the Resource Manager window, so its list names only the menus the tab adds to the shared menubar (recon from exe strings, unverified: Layout Preview, Imageset ImageSet, Styles WidgetStyle). The five sub-editors with no known tab menu have no entry and their L02 stays blocked; main adds the titles their L01 walk shows and re-emits the P4-9 queue. The RM menubar itself was walked in P4-1 under ResourceManager. The eight Resource Browser targets of uia_context are P4-9's L05 stretch block, one file per sub-editor.

uia_context.$comment: Caps and target list of the uia-context kind of scripts/live/dry-run.ts (Phase 4 L05, design 2.2): ShowContextMenu then Collapse on one right-click target. targets: {module?, path:[labels]} entries, written by main from E09 extensions and entity kinds; empty until the first L05 dry run proposes them. Whether Qt answers IUIAutomationElement3::ShowContextMenu is unverified; the first L05 step tests it.

dialog_openers.$comment: Phase 4 L04 (design 2.2): execute-action paths that open a dialog (the action carries opensDialog: true). Never an Appendix B list 1 opener (Create World, Create Terrain, Save World As, Pack Project, Publish, Login): the owner clicks those. Main lists the allow-listed openers; File > Options... is the D14 opener (World Editor and Resource Manager; the WE path is [unverified] until the first L04 run, and the handler-side allow list must list it too).
